blocking_issues.issue: The committed planning candidate still declares Current as planned and says that the five initial artifacts are not committed, so the plan's current state contradicts the reviewed candidate and cannot serve as truthful routing evidence.
blocking_issues.fix: Set Current to planning-candidate-committed, describe this exact five-path non-merge candidate as committed, and retain the transition into independent plan review. Commit the corrected five planning artifacts as a new candidate before re-review.

blocking_issues.issue: The allowed transitions admit only passing Tester evidence to reviewer-in-progress. A committed failing Tester evidence record has no declared transition to needs-rework or a new immutable implementation subject, leaving a required independent-Test failure path without a route.
blocking_issues.fix: Add an explicit tester-evidence-committed -> needs-rework transition for same-subject failing Tester evidence; require Planner to route bounded rework to Implementer, which creates a new immutable subject and repeats Tester then independent Reviewer evidence without reuse.
